jobs.title: Data & AI Transformation Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in integration and platform architecture focus on designing and implementing seamless integration solutions and robust platform architectures for clients. They enable efficient data flow and optimise technology infrastructure for enhanced business performance. Those in integration architecture at PwC will focus on designing and implementing seamless integration solutions to connect various organisational systems and applications. Your work will involve creating robust architectures that enable efficient data flow and enhance overall business processes.

The Opportunity

As a Data & AI Transformation Director, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. We are seeking a Director, Data & AI Transformation - Microsoft Practice to lead and deliver large-scale Microsoft-based transformation programs across cloud, data, analytics, and artificial intelligence. This individual will be responsible for owning end-to-end program delivery, managing executive stakeholder relationships, building high-performing delivery teams, and helping grow PwC's Microsoft consulting practice.

The successful candidate will combine deep expertise in Microsoft technologies, particularly Microsoft Azure and Microsoft AI Foundry, with proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs and offshore delivery organizations. This is a delivery-first leadership role focused on execution, client outcomes, and scaling delivery capabilities rather than pure sales or advisory responsibilities. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

Delivery Leadership & Program Ownership

Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale Microsoft Data, AI, and Cloud transformation programs.
Own program outcomes including scope, budget, governance, risk management, quality, and delivery success.
Lead multiple concurrent programs and workstreams across complex enterprise environments.
Establish effective delivery governance, escalation management, and executive reporting structures.
Drive successful outcomes across strategic transformation initiatives and managed delivery engagements.

Microsoft Data & AI Transformation

Lead delivery of solutions leveraging: Microsoft Azure; Microsoft AI Foundry; Azure AI Services; Microsoft Fabric; Enterprise Data Platforms; Modern Analytics Solutions.
Support clients in cloud modernization, data platform transformation, and enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
Develop delivery roadmaps that align technology investments with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
Provide practical guidance on enterprise Data & AI transformation approaches and operating models.

Executive Stakeholder Management

Build trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, technology leaders, and business executives.
Represent PwC during executive steering committees, governance reviews, and program leadership meetings.
Serve as the primary delivery lead for strategic client engagements.
Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and business impacts to executive stakeholders.
Facilitate decision-making across client, partner, and delivery teams.

Global Delivery & Offshore Leadership

Lead geographically distributed teams across Canada, the United States, and offshore delivery centres.
Manage complex global delivery models utilizing onshore and offshore resources.
Coordinate activities across delivery teams, vendors, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Establish delivery practices that support scalability, quality, accountability, and operational excellence.
Drive issue resolution, risk mitigation, and program recovery efforts where required.

Talent Development & Practice Growth

Build and scale high-performing delivery teams.
Leverage professional networks to identify, attract, and develop top Microsoft delivery talent.
Mentor Managers, Senior Managers, Architects, and Delivery Leaders.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the ongoing growth of PwC's Microsoft Data & AI practice.

Business Development & Alliance Growth

Support pursuits, proposals, executive presentations, and solution development activities.
Build and strengthen relationships with Microsoft and key client stakeholders.
Contribute to thought leadership and market-facing initiatives related to Microsoft Data & AI solutions.
Help develop delivery offerings, accelerators, and go-to-market capabilities.
Support long-term practice growth and strategic expansion objectives.

What You'll Bring

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

12+ years of professional experience in technology consulting, enterprise transformation, cloud delivery, or technology leadership.
10+ years of experience leading large-scale enterprise technology programs and delivery organizations.
Proven experience delivering Microsoft-based transformation programs.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern Microsoft Data & AI technologies.
Extensive experience managing offshore and global delivery teams.
Demonstrated success managing executive-level stakeholder relationships and steering committees.
Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams across delivery, architecture, engineering, and business functions.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and client relationship management capabilities.
Experience owning complex budgets, delivery risks, resource plans, and program governance.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead large-scale client engagements with limited oversight.

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $191,200 - $241,200. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.

Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

A connected and high-performing Talent Management portfolio that delivers measurable value to the business and our people.
Modern, competitive people programs that support attraction, retention, wellbeing and performance.
A workforce insights capability that enables stronger business, talent and workforce decisions.
Enhanced organizational effectiveness and readiness for future business challenges.
Efficient, scalable and employee-centric HR operations and services.

What You Bring

Significant senior HR leadership experience within a complex organization, including leadership of multiple enterprise talent management or centre-of-expertise functions.
Experience leading complex talent management portfolios, combined with deep expertise in one or more areas such as Total Rewards, People Analytics, organizational development, workforce planning or organizational effectiveness.
Experience leading the design, evolution or transformation of enterprise HR programs, functions or operating models.
A track record of using workforce data, analytics and organizational insights to influence business decisions and improve outcomes.
Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, with evidence of challenging traditional approaches and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience, organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
Strong understanding of emerging workforce trends and technologies, including artificial intelligence, and the ability to translate new capabilities into practical business, talent and workforce solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.
Demonstrated ability to align and lead diverse specialist teams, fostering collaboration, shared accountability and enterprise-wide outcomes across multiple HR disciplines.
Strong judgement and business acumen, with the ability to balance employee experience, business priorities, risk and operational realities.
Experience within professional services or another complex, relationship-driven organization would be considered a strong asset.
University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline. A relevant professional designation and/or advanced degree would be considered an asset.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who will own and drive the development of AI-powered communications surveillance products at RBC Capital Markets, combining deep full-stack engineering expertise with practical experience in AI/ML technologies — including LLM integration, AI agents, prompt engineering, and intelligent automation.

This role builds next-generation surveillance and compliance technology, architecting solutions that leverage GenAI to detect anomalies and surface actionable insights from complex and unstructured data. The ideal candidate has a track record of shipping production AI products, uses AI tools to accelerate delivery velocity, mentors developers in AI-augmented development practices, and collaborates cross-functionally with compliance, product, and data teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into measurable, deployed outcomes.

Location: This role can be based in either Halifax or Toronto.

What will you do?

Leads full-stack development of AI-powered products, owning architecture, implementation, and delivery across front-end, back-end, and AI/ML components. Hands-on with coding, testing, and troubleshooting to ensure applications meet performance and regulatory requirements.
Architects and implements AI/ML solutions including LLM integration, AI agents, prompt engineering, RAG, and intelligent automation. Designs systems that enhance alert generation, anomaly detection, and investigative analysis within the surveillance domain.
Uses AI tools to accelerate development velocity, establishing workflows with Copilot, GenAI assistants, and AI-powered development aids. Drives measurable throughput improvements by bridging expertise gaps, accelerating domain-specific coding, and expanding the team's capacity to ship more products per quarter.
Collaborates cross-functionally with surveillance stakeholders, compliance, product owners, and data engineering to define product roadmaps, gather requirements, and ensure AI products align with regulatory obligations and business priorities.
Mentors developers in AI-augmented practices, establishing coding standards, AI-assisted workflow guidelines, and best practices for human-AI collaboration. Builds team capabilities through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge transfer.
Evaluates emerging AI/ML technologies and frameworks for applicability, translating findings into actionable recommendations and proof-of-concept implementations. Ensures the team adopts tools that deliver genuine operational value.
Owns complex technical initiatives end-to-end, from architecture through production deployment and iteration. Provides decisive technical leadership in ambiguous situations and guides the team to deliver on schedule.
Builds strategic relationships with internal teams and external partners, aligning the AI product roadmap with business objectives. Represents the team's capabilities in stakeholder discussions and contributes to enterprise AI strategy.

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have:

Technical skills:

Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python (primary for AI/ML and automation), with experience in JavaScript/TypeScript and Java.
Full-Stack Frameworks: Deep knowledge of back-end frameworks (Node.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, or Django) and working knowledge of modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js)
AI/ML Technologies: Practical experience integrating LLMs, NLP, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks into production systems. Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, GenAI coding assistants).
Cloud and Infrastructure: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.
Data Engineering: Strong SQL skills, experience with relational and NoSQL databases, and familiarity with streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis) and pipeline tools (Airflow, Spark).
DevOps and Quality: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality tooling, and production monitoring.
AI Agent Development: Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows in enterprise or regulated environments.

Other skills:

Technical Leadership: Proven ability to lead teams, set technical direction, establish coding standards, and grow junior and intermediate developers.
Agile Delivery: Experience in agile environments collaborating with product owners, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to maintain steady delivery cadence.
Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate technical capabilities into business language, present roadmaps, and influence technology strategy with senior leadership.
Problem-Solving: Comfort in ambiguous environments with evolving requirements; willingness to prototype rapidly and iterate toward production-quality solutions.

Nice-to-have:

Enterprise AI Platforms: Experience with platforms such as Claude, Devin, Copilot or similar enterprise AI tools, including building on platform APIs and creating custom agents.
Communications Surveillance and Compliance Technology: Experience with surveillance systems, alert generation, case management, or compliance workflows; understanding of how AI can enhance detection accuracy and analyst productivity.
Regulatory Frameworks: Awareness of surveillance-relevant regulations (MAR, Dodd-Frank, MiFID II) and ability to translate regulatory requirements into technical specifications.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
Flexible work/life balance options.
Opportunities to building close relationships with clients.
Access to a variety of job opportunities across business and geographies.

Job Skills

Application Development, Application Development, Application Security, Application Testing, Architecture Design Patterns, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Technologies, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Collaboration, Communication, Data Analysis, Emerging Technologies, Full Stack Development, IT Service Design, IT Systems Integration, Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Problem Solving, Scrum (Agile), Scrum Software Development, Solution Architecture, System Performance, Technical Direction, Technical Knowledge {+ 2 more}

Identify and incubate new products, services, digital and data solutions, partnerships, and business models.
Govern opportunities from validation and business case through pilot, commercialization, and value realization.
Equip business leaders with disciplined innovation practices and recommend when to advance, pivot, pause, or stop initiatives.

Refresh HSB Canada’s IoT strategy, positioning, target segments, value propositions, ecosystem, and investment priorities.
Develop a go-to-market roadmap linking IoT-enabled risk solutions to underwriting, distribution, client needs, service delivery, and value creation.
Mobilize business, functional, and Group partners to move priority IoT opportunities from strategy to market.
Define measures for adoption, customer value, risk improvement, revenue, and profitability.
Market Insight, Executive Advisory and Group Integration
Turn customer, broker, competitor, technology, regulatory, and economic insights into actionable recommendations.
Align HSB Canada, HSB, and Munich Re Group stakeholders around shared outcomes, decisions, and timelines.
Lead high-priority cross-enterprise projects requiring structured problem solving, executive sponsorship, and coordinated execution.
Deliver Board-ready communications, represent HSB Canada in Group forums, and translate Group capabilities into Canadian opportunities.
People Leadership

Set clear priorities, delegate ownership, provide timely feedback, and hold the team accountable for results.
Build diverse talent and foster curiosity, constructive challenge, experimentation, and learning.

A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a related discipline is required. An MBA or other relevant graduate degree is an asset.

Quantitative and commercial acumen: Extrapolates insight from financial, operating, customer, and market data; builds robust business cases; and understands value drivers and trade-offs.
Executive influence: Engages confidently with the Board, CEO, Executive Leadership Team, business-unit leaders, and Group stakeholders; constructively challenges senior colleagues while building trust and alignment.

Your Opportunity

The Chief Information Officer (CIO)
is responsible for establishing and executing the firm's enterprise technology strategy, ensuring technology capabilities enable business growth, operational excellence, security, and an exceptional people experience.

Reporting to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, the CIO partners closely with Managing Partners, business leaders, and C-suite colleagues to align technology investments and services with strategic priorities. The CIO leads enterprise technology operations, architecture, infrastructure, end-user technology services, cybersecurity enablement, vendor partnerships, and workforce planning while fostering a modern, secure, and high-performing digital workplace.

The CIO is accountable for delivering reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that enable our people to do their best work and support the firm's continued growth and transformation. This role requires technical depth to guide architecture, platforms, security, data, integration, and service delivery decisions, combined with the business fluency to align stakeholders around practical outcomes.

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and operating plans aligned with firm priorities and business objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, Managing Partners, and business leaders, translating business priorities into practical technology initiatives with measurable outcomes and clear value realization.
Anticipate emerging technology trends and assess opportunities to leverage AI, automation, cloud, and modern workplace capabilities to improve productivity, employee experience, and business performance.
Communicate technology strategy, risks, investments, and outcomes in clear business terms and represent technology leadership in executive forums, governance committees, and strategic planning discussions.

Technology Operations, Digital Workplace & Resilience

You bring BDO's strategy to life by leading with genuine care, focusing on what matters most, embracing progress over preservation, and fostering a culture where people can do more together.

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Anticipate emerging technology trends and assess opportunities to leverage AI, automation, cloud, and modern workplace capabilities to improve productivity, employee experience, and business performance.
Communicate technology strategy, risks, investments, and outcomes in clear business terms and represent technology leadership in executive forums, governance committees, and strategic planning discussions.

Lead technical trade-off and investment discussions across modernization, build-versus-buy decisions, platform consolidation, integration patterns, technical debt, resiliency, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership.
Guide the evolution of cloud and hybrid platforms, enterprise integration, data platforms, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities in partnership with data, AI, security, and business leaders.
Drive modernization of infrastructure, networks, identity and access management, endpoint and collaboration platforms, monitoring, and operational tooling, supported by disciplined delivery practices such as DevSecOps, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business choices, risks, investment implications, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.

Establish service standards, operating metrics, and performance expectations, using employee feedback and service insights to continuously improve the technology experience.
Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resiliency, and technology adoption efforts while balancing user experience, accessibility, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Partner closely with Information Security leadership to maintain a strong enterprise security posture while enabling business agility, ensuring technology operates within established security, privacy, risk, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain effective technology governance, architecture standards, policies, controls, and risk-management practices that are measurable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
Develop and manage the enterprise technology budget and strategic vendor portfolio, overseeing sourcing, contract negotiations, performance, and investment decisions to maximize business value, service quality, and cost effectiveness.

You maximize value from technology investments through disciplined planning and execution, strong governance, strategic partnerships, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
The AML Story

We've come a long way. AML has 52 years of experience designing and building oceanographic instrumentation and we have clocked consistent year-on-year growth of greater than 15%. We have customers on all seven continents. We have a 70+ person team of employees that care deeply about customer outcomes. In our market, we are known for two things: 1) Going to the ends of the earth to make our customers successful; and 2) Bringing fresh ideas to an established market.
Earlier this year, we were acquired by Union Park Capital. Our mission? To drive the success of Union Park's marine technology thesis. AML is the operating foundation of that thesis, and our focus is on growing the core business while carefully extending our solution set via acquisition. We anticipate dramatic growth and significant change in the next 3 to 5 years.

How we Operate

At AML, we do things a bit differently. Think daily huddles. Think Rockefeller Habits, Scaling Up, and the One Page Plan. Think town hall meetings with on-the-fly Q&A sessions. If you are familiar with these concepts - or they are of interest to you - then you might be a fit for AML. We want people who want to commit their hands, their heads, and their hearts to their position. You see this commitment in our employee Glass Door rating: an impressive 4.70 on 5.00.

What you inherit

A 51-year-old marine instrumentation business with established customer relationships across seven continents. Operating in multiple currencies across Canada, the US, the UK with regular Foreign Exchange exposure. A finance team of 3 is anchored by an experienced Controller and Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable coordinators in Victoria BC. In this role, you will be hands on!
We are PE-backed and actively acquiring complementary marine-tech businesses. The PE sponsor handles deal sourcing, financial diligence, and capital structure decisions. You will inherit a clean but informal finance function — strong on transactional accuracy, building toward decision-useful insight.

Your Mission

Predictable Numbers! You will build AML's operating financial leadership. You will own the annual operating plan, the rolling forecast that tells the Leadership Team where we're headed, and the monthly reporting cadence that turns numbers into decisions. You will be the financial business-partner for the COO and the individual VPs of Business Units. You will absorb the financial operations of acquired companies onto AML's platform, post close. You will lead the Controller and the broader finance team into a culture of financial discipline.
As AML grows, this seat may evolve into a true CFO role; today the focus is sharp on operating financial leadership and platform integration.

What You'll be Accountable For

•      Owns the Operating Plan:
Are we tracking to the agreed upon plan?
•      Owns Forecast Accuracy:
How confident are we in our view of where the business is headed?
•      Owns Reporting Cadence:
Does the Leadership Team have the financial insight it needs?
•      Owns Cash Conversion Cycle:
Is AML's cash conversion cycle hitting target?
•      Owns Post-Close Financial Integration:
Can we see what we need to see, post close?
•      Plays for the First Team First:
Is Metronomics (the AML Way, 7 systems; core values; Group-level goals, priorities, plans, & cohesion all alive & well in the Finance function?
•      Curates a Team of A Players:
Are key players delivering A performances?
•      Drives Succession Plan Thinking:
Do key players on the team have ready successors?

Some Other Daily Duties

•     Runs the Operating Plan cycle (3 years, to varying degrees of resolution) department-by-department; aggregates into the Leadership Team-blessed plan; coordinates the commitments to shareholders.
•     Owns weekly forecast refresh for cash, EBITDA, and full-year landing; improves forecast accuracy.
•     Builds the monthly Leadership Team financial pack; writes variance commentary; ensures pack lands ≥3 days before Leadership Team meeting.
•     Daily refresh of cash projection; identifies cash levers early; coordinates with Controller on Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable / banking ops to hit the projection.
•     Active business-partnering relationship with VP of Business Unit, COO, CCO, CTO, CPO; on-call financial counsel for material decisions.
•     Holds Controller accountable for close cadence, statutory reporting, audit readiness, and Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable / General Ledger / tax compliance operations.
•     Owns the operating-side prep for quarterly reporting cycle; ensures package is delivered on cadence with consistent narrative.
•     For each AML acquisition: leads the financial integration playbook from Day 0 through Day 180; coordinates with sponsor on diligence-to-integration handoff.
•     Selects, maintains, and scales the Financial Planning & Analysis stack (planning tool, Business Intelligence / dashboard layer, forecast model architecture); partners with VP of S&S on integration with Enterprise Resource Planning / Customer Relationship Management.

Your Skills & Competencies

•      Financial Planning & Analysis Fluency:
Technical fluency in plans, variance, and forecasts. Instinct for when a number is wrong.
•      Operational P&L Literacy:
Sight for margin compression and working-capital drag. Numbers read as operating moves, not just facts.
•      Cash Position Sense:
Anticipation of cash events. Awareness of bookings-to-cash drag before it lands on the balance sheet.
•      Numbers-to-Decisions Translation:
Translation of variance into "what should we do." Anticipation of the next question.
•      Methodology Implementation & Stewardship:
Capacity for turning systems from policy into habit. Patience for the long adoption arc.
•      Financial Systems Architecture for Scale:
Architectural sense for tooling that holds at 2-3× scale, including post-acquisition shape.
•      Talent Density Discipline:
Clear sight of each direct report's ceiling. Bench depth as a leadership input, not output.
•      Coaching & Emotional Intelligence:
In-the-moment read on what a person needs. Calibration of feedback for impact, not comfort.

What Other Experience is Required?

Education

Bachelor’s in finance, accounting, economics, or business required. CPA, CMA, or MBA strongly preferred. CFA a plus.
Experience

10+ years finance leadership experience. At least one cycle running Financial Planning & Analysis at a $25M-$100M company. Hands-on experience building operating plans, running rolling forecast cycles, and partnering with Business Unit leaders. Track record of producing decision-useful management reporting (not just compliance reporting). Growth-stage operating experience strongly preferred. Direct experience with post-close financial integration of acquired entities a strong plus.
Industry Background

Marine / oceanographic / industrial sensors / scientific instruments preferred but not required. PE-backed operating experience preferred. Multi-jurisdiction (Canada / US / UK) operating experience a plus given AML's geographic footprint.
Other

Canadian work authorization (or eligibility). Willingness to be based in Victoria BC or Halifax NS with periodic travel. Comfortable being the senior financial voice in a Leadership Team that does not currently include a CFO.

How to Apply?

Please send your complete history to hr @ AMLoceanographic.com IMPORTANT: In your cover letter, please: 1) speak to what you'd do in your first 100 days in the role; 2) identify the 3 most impactful professional lessons you've learned, with specific examples from your career; and 3) name your personal core values, along with relevant examples of how you've applied each value to guide high stakes professional decisions.

Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Work you'll do

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The Director, Data Management & AI Readiness is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, operating model, and delivery of enterprise data management capabilities.

The role is the business owner for cross-domain data management capabilities that serve the Deloitte network, including Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Quality, Taxonomy Management, Reference Data, and Data Modeling.

Working across global applications, business functions, architecture teams, product organizations, and operational teams, the Director will establish scalable data management processes, drive adoption of enterprise standards and procedures, and develop trusted data assets for business operations, analytics, AI, regulatory compliance, and decision-making.

This leader serves as a key connector between business executives, application owners, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and technology teams, aligning diverse stakeholder perspectives and driving consensus on complex data management decisions across a global organization. This role is expected to establish measurable outcomes, monitor performance, and continuously evolve enterprise data management capabilities to an aligned target state and maturity model that the role will also define and govern.

The DSGO is responsible for building an integrated strategy and operating model to manage global data and AI products across their lifecycle, enabling better business outcomes, innovation, and client service.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership
Define and execute the data management strategy for:
Master Data Management
Metadata Management
Ontology and Context Management
Data Quality
Taxonomy and Reference Data
Enterprise Data Models

Develop multi-year roadmaps that align to business priorities, digital transformation objectives, and AI enablement goals.
Establish and evolve enterprise operating models, governance forums, stewardship structures, and accountability frameworks.
Champion the importance of trusted, governed data as a strategic enterprise asset.
Lead a global team of data management professionals and subject matter experts.
Data Management Operating Model Development
Design and implement sustainable operating models supporting global and regional data domains.
Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and governance forums.
Build effective collaboration models between:
Business teams
Application owners
Product teams
Enterprise Architecture
Operations teams
Data and analytics functions

Establish service delivery models that enable consistent execution across multiple geographies and applications.
Drive adoption of standardized data management processes for, metadata, data quality, data architecture, taxonomy, and data quality remediation.
Master Data & Reference Data Management
Lead enterprise master data programs across key domains such as Customer, Vendor, Products, and People.
Define authoritative sources, golden record strategies, hierarchy management approaches, and lifecycle management processes.
Establish data management practices for reference data and shared enterprise dimensions.
Partner with business and technology leaders to modernize master data capabilities and improve operational efficiency.
Metadata, Taxonomy & Data Modeling
Establish enterprise metadata management capabilities including technical, operational, and AI metadata.
Enable the integration of business glossaries and semantic frameworks across applications and data products.
Lead development of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling standards.
Ensure enterprise data structures support interoperability, analytics, AI, and future platform modernization initiatives.
Data Quality & Measurement
Lead enterprise data quality management capabilities including strategy, frameworks, procedures, monitoring, and remediation
Operationalize quality dimensions, monitoring capabilities, issue management processes, and continuous improvement practices.
Partner with business and technology teams to improve the quality, consistency, integrity and usability of enterprise data across critical business domains.
Define and implement enterprise measurement frameworks, KPIs, and scorecards to assess the effectiveness and maturity of data management capabilities, including data issue resolution and remediation
Build executive dashboards and performance reporting that provide visibility into enterprise data health, operational performance, risks, and business outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement programs using quantitative performance measures, automation and operational metrics to increase the effectiveness of enterprise data management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Influence
Build trusted relationships with senior executives, business leaders, product leaders, architects, and operations leaders.
Facilitate decision-making across highly complex environments with competing priorities and differing viewpoints.
Lead discussions where stakeholder opinions may be polarized and drive alignment toward enterprise outcomes.
Negotiate priorities, funding, resource commitments, and roadmap decisions across organizational boundaries.
Influence and build consensus without authority in a highly matrixed global environment.
Present program strategy, risks, decisions, and results to executive and governance forums.
Innovation & Capability Development
Identify new capabilities required to support enterprise data and AI strategies.
Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and operating practices.
Lead modernization initiatives related to:
Data governance
Metadata platforms
Data quality tooling
Master data platforms
AI-ready data foundations
AI-auditability for data assets

Build communities of practice and increase organizational data management maturity

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

Key Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Data Management, Business, or related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
12+ years of experience in enterprise data management, data governance, data architecture, or related disciplines.
7+ years leading global teams and enterprise-scale transformation initiatives.
Proven leadership of master data, metadata, data quality, taxonomy, or data governance programs as the voice of the business with technical teams, particularly for cross-domain data assets. Experience with data governance tools such as Informatica, SAP MDG, Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, etc.
Experience establishing operating models and governance frameworks across multiple business units and geographies. Experience working closely with application and operations teams in large, federated organizations.
Confident communicator with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership teams. Able to translate complex data concepts into business outcomes.
Ability to build strong relationships across organizational boundaries, acting as a trusted advisor to executives, business leaders, architects, product teams, and internal customers represented across multiple geographies.

À propos de Genetec :

Genetec est à la pointe des technologies de sécurité et d'exploitation, et stimule l'innovation pour renforcer la sécurité et l'efficacité à l'échelle mondiale. Au sein de notre Digital Information Office (DIO), nous développons et exploitons des solutions numériques qui soutiennent les fonctions métier essentielles dans les domaines de la finance, du juridique, des opérations, des ventes, du marketing et auprès d'autres parties prenantes internes.

Alors que notre écosystème numérique ne cesse de se développer, nous recherchons un directeur des plateformes numériques et de l'excellence opérationnelle chargé de mettre en place et de faire évoluer les plateformes, les pratiques et les normes de qualité qui permettent à nos équipes de développement de fournir des solutions fiables, évolutives et sécurisées pour l'ensemble du portefeuille du DIO.

Aperçu du poste :

Nous recherchons un(e) directeur(trice) des plateformes numériques internes et de l'excellence opérationnelle pour diriger les plateformes internes partagées, les pratiques de qualité et les capacités de livraison qui soutiennent le développement logiciel au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO).

Ce poste consiste à définir et à mettre en œuvre les normes, les cadres de qualité, les plateformes de livraison et les pratiques de développement utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO. Les domaines de responsabilité comprennent l'assurance qualité, les pipelines CI/CD, les plateformes de développement internes, les normes de livraison logicielle et la gouvernance des API.

Ce poste est idéal pour un(e) leader pragmatique et axé sur l'exécution, capable d'améliorer la qualité, la cohérence et les performances de livraison tout en établissant des partenariats solides entre les équipes du DIO. Pour réussir dans cette fonction, il est nécessaire d'avoir occupé certains ou plusieurs des postes énumérés. Ce poste s'adresse à ceux qui sont prêts à retrousser leurs manches et à construire quelque chose d'évolutif.

Responsabilités principales :

Stratégie et feuille de route

Élaborer, définir et susciter l'adhésion à la stratégie d'ingénierie, hiérarchiser les priorités et aligner tous les objectifs sur les objectifs généraux de l'organisation
Élaborer une feuille de route claire sur 18 à 24 mois tenant compte des contraintes et des dépendances, et permettant de réaffecter les ressources et de s'adapter aux événements métier tout au long du processus
Promouvoir l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle au sein des équipes technologiques de l'organisation

Organisation

Concevoir et faire évoluer les structures des équipes, allouer les ressources et mettre en place des processus qui favorisent la réussite à long terme des collaborateurs et du département
Recruter, organiser et développer les talents, notamment en investissant de manière réfléchie dans les parcours professionnels et la relève

Normes de développement et qualité

Assurer la maîtrise des normes de développement logiciel et des pratiques de qualité au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO)
Définir, publier et améliorer en permanence les normes de développement, les pratiques de codage et les contrôles de qualité utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO
Diriger la fonction d'assurance qualité, notamment la stratégie de test, les pratiques d'automatisation, les critères de préparation à la mise en production et la gouvernance de la qualité en tant que capacité partagée
Assurer la visibilité sur les tendances en matière de qualité et l'état de santé des livraisons, permettant ainsi une prise de décision éclairée au sein de l'équipe de direction du DIO
Définir et maintenir les pratiques de gouvernance des déploiements, notamment les revues de préparation, les contrôles de qualité et les contrôles de mise en production

Plateformes de développement et DevOps

Définir les orientations de la stratégie et des outils de la plateforme CI/CD, en veillant à ce que les équipes de développement disposent de processus fiables et efficaces pour la création, les tests et le déploiement des applications
Assurer la gestion et l'évolution de l'infrastructure de développement, des environnements, des outils et des plateformes de développement de DIO, en mettant l'accent sur la fiabilité, l'évolutivité, l'optimisation des coûts et la productivité des développeurs
Réduire les frictions liées à la mise en production en standardisant et en simplifiant les workflows de développement et les capacités de la plateforme
Encourager l'adoption de pratiques modernes de livraison logicielle et d'automatisation au sein des équipes DIO

Interfaces numériques et gouvernance des API

Définir et promouvoir une approche « API-first » pour les solutions et intégrations DIO
Établir des normes en matière de conception, de documentation, de gestion du cycle de vie, de sécurité et de gestion des versions des API
Veiller à ce que les pratiques de gouvernance des API soient intégrées dans les workflows de développement, les contrôles qualité et les pipelines de livraison
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes chargées de la plateforme API et de l'intégration afin d'harmoniser les normes, les outils et les approches de mise en œuvre
Favoriser les modèles de services et d'intégration réutilisables qui améliorent l'interopérabilité entre les systèmes métier

Direction d'équipe et développement des compétences

Diriger, encadrer et faire évoluer une équipe composée de responsables et de collaborateurs dans les domaines de l'assurance qualité, de l'ingénierie des plateformes, du DevOps et de l'accompagnement au développement
Évaluer les capacités de l'organisation et développer de manière proactive les compétences en matière de qualité logicielle, d'automatisation, de plateformes cloud et de pratiques de livraison
Favoriser une culture collaborative et axée sur le service, fondée sur le partenariat, l'accompagnement et l'amélioration continue
Renforcer sa crédibilité et son influence grâce à son expertise, à la collaboration et à des résultats mesurables

Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline technique connexe
Un master ou un MBA est considéré comme un atout
Plus de 12 ans d'expérience dans le développement logiciel et à des postes de direction technique
Expérience avérée dans la mise en place de normes de livraison logicielle, de pratiques d'assurance qualité et de capacités CI/CD dans des environnements complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes
Solide expérience des indicateurs de livraison (DORA ou équivalent) et de l'utilisation d'analyses basées sur les données pour améliorer la qualité et les résultats de livraison
Expérience dans la direction de fonctions liées aux plateformes, au DevOps, à l'assurance qualité ou à l'habilitation technologique, en soutien à plusieurs équipes de livraison
Solide expérience en automatisation des builds et des mises en production, en stratégies de test, en plateformes cloud et en outils de développement
Capacité avérée à influencer les résultats au sein des équipes et auprès des parties prenantes sans lien hiérarchique direct
Expérience au sein d'entreprises spécialisées dans les logiciels d'entreprise, le SaaS ou les technologies B2B
Grande crédibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement tant avec un public technique qu'avec un public métier
Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite d'interagir avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)

Leader axé(e) sur l'exécution, soucieux(euse) de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la qualité et des résultats mesurables
Collaboratif(ve) et accessible, capable de faire respecter les normes tout en entretenant des partenariats solides
Excellent(e) communicateur(trice), capable de simplifier les questions complexes et de susciter l'adhésion de divers groupes de parties prenantes
Leader soucieux(euse) du service, sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre gouvernance et accompagnement
Engagé(e) en faveur de l'amélioration continue et de la promotion d'une culture de haute performance

Qualités souhaitées:

Expérience dans la modernisation d'applications héritées vers des architectures orientées services ou natives du cloud
Expérience dans la direction d'équipes techniques distribuées ou dispersées à l'échelle mondiale
Bonne connaissance des plateformes d'entreprise, des systèmes métier internes et des initiatives de transformation numérique
Expérience dans la mise en place de capacités de prise en charge des plateformes et de la mise en œuvre au sein d'une organisation technologique interne

Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Digital Marketing Director you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
to lead enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, management reporting and business performance analytics. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer
, this role will be a key partner to executive leadership, business unit leaders and our private equity sponsor. The VP, FP&A will help build a scalable, data-driven FP&A function and play an important role in Opensity's continued growth, M&A activity and long-term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning across the organization.
Own monthly and quarterly management reporting, variance analysis and executive performance reviews.
Develop actionable financial and operational KPIs across revenue, margin, headcount, productivity, cash flow and profitability.
Build robust recurring revenue analytics, including bookings, backlog, retention, churn, expansion and customer-level performance.
Partner with business leaders to improve forecast accuracy, financial accountability and operating performance.
Lead customer, service-line and business-unit profitability analysis to support pricing, investment and resource allocation decisions.
Drive automation and modernization of FP&A, including dashboards, reporting, forecasting and data analysis.
Support the CFO with Board, lender and private equity sponsor reporting.
Support M&A diligence, integration, synergy tracking and post-acquisition performance management.
Help maintain a strong, diligence-ready Finance organization and support future refinancing, recapitalization or exit processes.
Lead and develop the FP&A team.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field.
10+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant FP&A leadership experience.
Private equity-backed company experience required.
Experience working through a private equity exit, sale process, recapitalization or similar transaction strongly preferred.
Strong experience with recurring revenue businesses and associated KPIs and analytics.
Meaningful M&A and post-acquisition integration experience required.
Strong data analytics capabilities with demonstrated experience automating financial reporting and analysis.
Experience in technology-enabled services, managed services, professional services, business services or SaaS strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting and executive presentation skills.
Experience working with Boards, senior executives and private equity sponsors.
Experience with planning, ERP and BI tools such as Sage Intacct, Adaptive, Anaplan, OneStream, Power BI or similar platforms.
CPA, CFA or MBA preferred but not required.
Strong leadership, communication and business-partnering skills.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation and performance-based annual bonus.

new_jobs.description:
The AML Story

We've come a long way. AML has 52 years of experience designing and building oceanographic instrumentation and we have clocked consistent year-on-year growth of greater than 15%. We have customers on all seven continents. We have a 70+ person team of employees that care deeply about customer outcomes. In our market, we are known for two things: 1) Going to the ends of the earth to make our customers successful; and 2) Bringing fresh ideas to an established market.
Earlier this year, we were acquired by Union Park Capital. Our mission? To drive the success of Union Park's marine technology thesis. AML is the operating foundation of that thesis, and our focus is on growing the core business while carefully extending our solution set via acquisition. We anticipate dramatic growth and significant change in the next 3 to 5 years.

How we Operate

At AML, we do things a bit differently. Think daily huddles. Think Rockefeller Habits, Scaling Up, and the One Page Plan. Think town hall meetings with on-the-fly Q&A sessions. If you are familiar with these concepts - or they are of interest to you - then you might be a fit for AML. We want people who want to commit their hands, their heads, and their hearts to their position. You see this commitment in our employee Glass Door rating: an impressive 4.70 on 5.00.

What you inherit

A 51-year-old marine instrumentation business with established customer relationships across seven continents. Operating in multiple currencies across Canada, the US, the UK with regular Foreign Exchange exposure. A finance team of 3 is anchored by an experienced Controller and Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable coordinators in Victoria BC. In this role, you will be hands on!
We are PE-backed and actively acquiring complementary marine-tech businesses. The PE sponsor handles deal sourcing, financial diligence, and capital structure decisions. You will inherit a clean but informal finance function — strong on transactional accuracy, building toward decision-useful insight.

Your Mission

Predictable Numbers! You will build AML's operating financial leadership. You will own the annual operating plan, the rolling forecast that tells the Leadership Team where we're headed, and the monthly reporting cadence that turns numbers into decisions. You will be the financial business-partner for the COO and the individual VPs of Business Units. You will absorb the financial operations of acquired companies onto AML's platform, post close. You will lead the Controller and the broader finance team into a culture of financial discipline.
As AML grows, this seat may evolve into a true CFO role; today the focus is sharp on operating financial leadership and platform integration.

What You'll be Accountable For

•      Owns the Operating Plan:
Are we tracking to the agreed upon plan?
•      Owns Forecast Accuracy:
How confident are we in our view of where the business is headed?
•      Owns Reporting Cadence:
Does the Leadership Team have the financial insight it needs?
•      Owns Cash Conversion Cycle:
Is AML's cash conversion cycle hitting target?
•      Owns Post-Close Financial Integration:
Can we see what we need to see, post close?
•      Plays for the First Team First:
Is Metronomics (the AML Way, 7 systems; core values; Group-level goals, priorities, plans, & cohesion all alive & well in the Finance function?
•      Curates a Team of A Players:
Are key players delivering A performances?
•      Drives Succession Plan Thinking:
Do key players on the team have ready successors?

Some Other Daily Duties

•     Runs the Operating Plan cycle (3 years, to varying degrees of resolution) department-by-department; aggregates into the Leadership Team-blessed plan; coordinates the commitments to shareholders.
•     Owns weekly forecast refresh for cash, EBITDA, and full-year landing; improves forecast accuracy.
•     Builds the monthly Leadership Team financial pack; writes variance commentary; ensures pack lands ≥3 days before Leadership Team meeting.
•     Daily refresh of cash projection; identifies cash levers early; coordinates with Controller on Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable / banking ops to hit the projection.
•     Active business-partnering relationship with VP of Business Unit, COO, CCO, CTO, CPO; on-call financial counsel for material decisions.
•     Holds Controller accountable for close cadence, statutory reporting, audit readiness, and Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable / General Ledger / tax compliance operations.
•     Owns the operating-side prep for quarterly reporting cycle; ensures package is delivered on cadence with consistent narrative.
•     For each AML acquisition: leads the financial integration playbook from Day 0 through Day 180; coordinates with sponsor on diligence-to-integration handoff.
•     Selects, maintains, and scales the Financial Planning & Analysis stack (planning tool, Business Intelligence / dashboard layer, forecast model architecture); partners with VP of S&S on integration with Enterprise Resource Planning / Customer Relationship Management.

Your Skills & Competencies

•      Financial Planning & Analysis Fluency:
Technical fluency in plans, variance, and forecasts. Instinct for when a number is wrong.
•      Operational P&L Literacy:
Sight for margin compression and working-capital drag. Numbers read as operating moves, not just facts.
•      Cash Position Sense:
Anticipation of cash events. Awareness of bookings-to-cash drag before it lands on the balance sheet.
•      Numbers-to-Decisions Translation:
Translation of variance into "what should we do." Anticipation of the next question.
•      Methodology Implementation & Stewardship:
Capacity for turning systems from policy into habit. Patience for the long adoption arc.
•      Financial Systems Architecture for Scale:
Architectural sense for tooling that holds at 2-3× scale, including post-acquisition shape.
•      Talent Density Discipline:
Clear sight of each direct report's ceiling. Bench depth as a leadership input, not output.
•      Coaching & Emotional Intelligence:
In-the-moment read on what a person needs. Calibration of feedback for impact, not comfort.

What Other Experience is Required?

Education

Bachelor’s in finance, accounting, economics, or business required. CPA, CMA, or MBA strongly preferred. CFA a plus.
Experience

10+ years finance leadership experience. At least one cycle running Financial Planning & Analysis at a $25M-$100M company. Hands-on experience building operating plans, running rolling forecast cycles, and partnering with Business Unit leaders. Track record of producing decision-useful management reporting (not just compliance reporting). Growth-stage operating experience strongly preferred. Direct experience with post-close financial integration of acquired entities a strong plus.
Industry Background

Marine / oceanographic / industrial sensors / scientific instruments preferred but not required. PE-backed operating experience preferred. Multi-jurisdiction (Canada / US / UK) operating experience a plus given AML's geographic footprint.
Other

Canadian work authorization (or eligibility). Willingness to be based in Victoria BC or Halifax NS with periodic travel. Comfortable being the senior financial voice in a Leadership Team that does not currently include a CFO.

How to Apply?

Please send your complete history to hr @ AMLoceanographic.com IMPORTANT: In your cover letter, please: 1) speak to what you'd do in your first 100 days in the role; 2) identify the 3 most impactful professional lessons you've learned, with specific examples from your career; and 3) name your personal core values, along with relevant examples of how you've applied each value to guide high stakes professional decisions.

À propos de Genetec :

Genetec est à la pointe des technologies de sécurité et d'exploitation, et stimule l'innovation pour renforcer la sécurité et l'efficacité à l'échelle mondiale. Au sein de notre Digital Information Office (DIO), nous développons et exploitons des solutions numériques qui soutiennent les fonctions métier essentielles dans les domaines de la finance, du juridique, des opérations, des ventes, du marketing et auprès d'autres parties prenantes internes.

Alors que notre écosystème numérique ne cesse de se développer, nous recherchons un directeur des plateformes numériques et de l'excellence opérationnelle chargé de mettre en place et de faire évoluer les plateformes, les pratiques et les normes de qualité qui permettent à nos équipes de développement de fournir des solutions fiables, évolutives et sécurisées pour l'ensemble du portefeuille du DIO.

Aperçu du poste :

Nous recherchons un(e) directeur(trice) des plateformes numériques internes et de l'excellence opérationnelle pour diriger les plateformes internes partagées, les pratiques de qualité et les capacités de livraison qui soutiennent le développement logiciel au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO).

Ce poste consiste à définir et à mettre en œuvre les normes, les cadres de qualité, les plateformes de livraison et les pratiques de développement utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO. Les domaines de responsabilité comprennent l'assurance qualité, les pipelines CI/CD, les plateformes de développement internes, les normes de livraison logicielle et la gouvernance des API.

Ce poste est idéal pour un(e) leader pragmatique et axé sur l'exécution, capable d'améliorer la qualité, la cohérence et les performances de livraison tout en établissant des partenariats solides entre les équipes du DIO. Pour réussir dans cette fonction, il est nécessaire d'avoir occupé certains ou plusieurs des postes énumérés. Ce poste s'adresse à ceux qui sont prêts à retrousser leurs manches et à construire quelque chose d'évolutif.

Responsabilités principales :

Stratégie et feuille de route

Élaborer, définir et susciter l'adhésion à la stratégie d'ingénierie, hiérarchiser les priorités et aligner tous les objectifs sur les objectifs généraux de l'organisation
Élaborer une feuille de route claire sur 18 à 24 mois tenant compte des contraintes et des dépendances, et permettant de réaffecter les ressources et de s'adapter aux événements métier tout au long du processus
Promouvoir l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle au sein des équipes technologiques de l'organisation

Organisation

Concevoir et faire évoluer les structures des équipes, allouer les ressources et mettre en place des processus qui favorisent la réussite à long terme des collaborateurs et du département
Recruter, organiser et développer les talents, notamment en investissant de manière réfléchie dans les parcours professionnels et la relève

Normes de développement et qualité

Assurer la maîtrise des normes de développement logiciel et des pratiques de qualité au sein du Digital Information Office (DIO)
Définir, publier et améliorer en permanence les normes de développement, les pratiques de codage et les contrôles de qualité utilisés par les équipes applicatives du DIO
Diriger la fonction d'assurance qualité, notamment la stratégie de test, les pratiques d'automatisation, les critères de préparation à la mise en production et la gouvernance de la qualité en tant que capacité partagée
Assurer la visibilité sur les tendances en matière de qualité et l'état de santé des livraisons, permettant ainsi une prise de décision éclairée au sein de l'équipe de direction du DIO
Définir et maintenir les pratiques de gouvernance des déploiements, notamment les revues de préparation, les contrôles de qualité et les contrôles de mise en production

Plateformes de développement et DevOps

Définir les orientations de la stratégie et des outils de la plateforme CI/CD, en veillant à ce que les équipes de développement disposent de processus fiables et efficaces pour la création, les tests et le déploiement des applications
Assurer la gestion et l'évolution de l'infrastructure de développement, des environnements, des outils et des plateformes de développement de DIO, en mettant l'accent sur la fiabilité, l'évolutivité, l'optimisation des coûts et la productivité des développeurs
Réduire les frictions liées à la mise en production en standardisant et en simplifiant les workflows de développement et les capacités de la plateforme
Encourager l'adoption de pratiques modernes de livraison logicielle et d'automatisation au sein des équipes DIO

Interfaces numériques et gouvernance des API

Définir et promouvoir une approche « API-first » pour les solutions et intégrations DIO
Établir des normes en matière de conception, de documentation, de gestion du cycle de vie, de sécurité et de gestion des versions des API
Veiller à ce que les pratiques de gouvernance des API soient intégrées dans les workflows de développement, les contrôles qualité et les pipelines de livraison
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes chargées de la plateforme API et de l'intégration afin d'harmoniser les normes, les outils et les approches de mise en œuvre
Favoriser les modèles de services et d'intégration réutilisables qui améliorent l'interopérabilité entre les systèmes métier

Direction d'équipe et développement des compétences

Diriger, encadrer et faire évoluer une équipe composée de responsables et de collaborateurs dans les domaines de l'assurance qualité, de l'ingénierie des plateformes, du DevOps et de l'accompagnement au développement
Évaluer les capacités de l'organisation et développer de manière proactive les compétences en matière de qualité logicielle, d'automatisation, de plateformes cloud et de pratiques de livraison
Favoriser une culture collaborative et axée sur le service, fondée sur le partenariat, l'accompagnement et l'amélioration continue
Renforcer sa crédibilité et son influence grâce à son expertise, à la collaboration et à des résultats mesurables

Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline technique connexe
Un master ou un MBA est considéré comme un atout
Plus de 12 ans d'expérience dans le développement logiciel et à des postes de direction technique
Expérience avérée dans la mise en place de normes de livraison logicielle, de pratiques d'assurance qualité et de capacités CI/CD dans des environnements complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes
Solide expérience des indicateurs de livraison (DORA ou équivalent) et de l'utilisation d'analyses basées sur les données pour améliorer la qualité et les résultats de livraison
Expérience dans la direction de fonctions liées aux plateformes, au DevOps, à l'assurance qualité ou à l'habilitation technologique, en soutien à plusieurs équipes de livraison
Solide expérience en automatisation des builds et des mises en production, en stratégies de test, en plateformes cloud et en outils de développement
Capacité avérée à influencer les résultats au sein des équipes et auprès des parties prenantes sans lien hiérarchique direct
Expérience au sein d'entreprises spécialisées dans les logiciels d'entreprise, le SaaS ou les technologies B2B
Grande crédibilité technique et capacité à communiquer efficacement tant avec un public technique qu'avec un public métier
Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite d'interagir avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)

Qualités de leader :

Leader axé(e) sur l'exécution, soucieux(euse) de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la qualité et des résultats mesurables
Collaboratif(ve) et accessible, capable de faire respecter les normes tout en entretenant des partenariats solides
Excellent(e) communicateur(trice), capable de simplifier les questions complexes et de susciter l'adhésion de divers groupes de parties prenantes
Leader soucieux(euse) du service, sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre gouvernance et accompagnement
Engagé(e) en faveur de l'amélioration continue et de la promotion d'une culture de haute performance

Qualités souhaitées:

Expérience dans la modernisation d'applications héritées vers des architectures orientées services ou natives du cloud
Expérience dans la direction d'équipes techniques distribuées ou dispersées à l'échelle mondiale
Bonne connaissance des plateformes d'entreprise, des systèmes métier internes et des initiatives de transformation numérique
Expérience dans la mise en place de capacités de prise en charge des plateformes et de la mise en œuvre au sein d'une organisation technologique interne

Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Digital Marketing Director you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
